new_scholarship.description: The University of Bologna awards 30 International Talents @unibo study grants each year to international students who matriculate for the first time in the first year of a Second Cycle (Laurea Magistrale) degree programme. Each grant is worth EUR 6,500 gross per academic year and is awarded for two academic years, and successful applicants also receive a full tuition fee waiver, paying only EUR 157.04 in regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium. Selection is based on GRE General Test scores, with minimum scores of 290 in the combined Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning sections and 3.0 in Analytical Writing, together with a family economic situation within an ISEE band of EUR 16,000 to EUR 35,000. Applicants must be under 30 years old at the deadline and must not already be a student of the University of Bologna.

new_scholarship.program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in a completely English-taught degree programme: 2 years for master's degree programmes, 3 years for bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes
new_scholarship.description: The University of Padua awards up to 76 Padua International Excellence Scholarships each year to the most deserving international candidate on each degree programme delivered entirely in English. Each scholarship is worth EUR 8,000.00 gross per academic year plus full exemption from student fees, leaving only the regional right-to-education tax and the revenue stamp payable. There is no separate scholarship application: applying to an eligible English-taught degree programme by its admission deadline makes the candidate eligible automatically. Selection is made by the Teaching Committee of each degree programme on academic excellence and the quality of the candidate's prior academic record, with the youngest candidate preferred in a tie.

new_scholarship.deadline: There is no separate scholarship deadline: the application for the degree programme automatically makes the candidate eligible, so the deadline is the admission deadline of the chosen degree programme, published in its Admission Notice. For the 2026/2027 cycle the official call set first application periods of 2 November 2025 to 2 February 2026 for unlimited-access programmes and 7 January to 7 March 2026 for limited-access programmes, with scholarship results published from 11 March 2026 and 10 April 2026 respectively. The 2027/2028 call is due in November 2026.

logo_override.validation_detail: svg 3057B, probed twice and confirmed: webfetch returned the full SVG source (HTTP 200, image/svg+xml) and the markup is a single path with fill="#0046AD", Bocconi's blue, on a transparent field, giving strong contrast on a white card. research_notes.logo: Bocconi renders its header logo as an inline SVG (id="logo-bocconi", viewBox 0 0 188 40) with no src, so there was nothing to probe on the page itself. A scan of the page returned only favicons, footer social icons and a "Bocconi Shop logo", all of which fail the brief. Following the brief's step 2, I opened the University's own corporate-identity page on unibocconi.it and then probed the theme asset directory convention. Two candidate paths 404'd; /themes/contrib/bocconi_ds/logo.svg returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/svg+xml and 3057 bytes, and webfetch independently returned its source showing a single path filled #0046AD. Because its path data matches the inline header SVG exactly, it is confirmed to be the University's primary logo. Third-party logo repositories surfaced by search (brandfetch, Wikimedia Commons, latestlogo, TopApk) were all rejected as banned third-party hosts.

new_scholarship.description: Talents 4 UniTo is the University of Turin's programme of 40 two-year scholarships for talented international students enrolling for the first time in a postgraduate degree without a restricted number of places taught in English. Each scholarship is worth EUR 20,000 gross in total (EUR 10,000 per academic year) and holders are exempt from university tuition fees, except for the first instalment due for enrolment in each academic year. Candidates are international students who hold a qualification obtained outside the Italian system valid for admission to a postgraduate degree, do not hold Italian citizenship and are not resident in Italy. There is no separate application form: applicants are included automatically if they apply on apply.unito.it for up to two eligible programmes during the published window. Selection is carried out per programme by an Evaluation Teaching Committee on a 50-point scale with a 36-point eligibility threshold, and two scholarships are awarded per programme.

new_scholarship.description: UNICORE 8.0 (University Corridors for Refugees) is a project promoted by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees that creates educational corridors from selected countries in Africa and Asia to Italy, in partnership with MAECI, Caritas Italiana, Diaconia Valdese and a group of Italian universities. Each scholarship provides a cash benefit of EUR 7,000 gross per academic year plus exemption from all amounts due for university enrolment, except the first instalment of the student contribution.
